criteria.description: Code executes through a permitted route inside the real installed ZZZ Steam workflow.
Actual Fortnite content or events influence the mission, with provenance; no encrypted files or client modification.
One player can accept, advance and complete the mission inside ZZZ.
Completion responds to an actual PvE encounter event from ZZZ, not a synthetic event.
One completion grants the specified real reward once; duplicate completion does not duplicate loot.
Installed-game versions, permission and one-click Melty installation verified without bypassing protections.
Current-version integration run, provenance and gameplay evidence reviewed.
